summary: Static jar assets and data resources were extracted from the local All of Create - Aeronautics Prism instance mod jars, including blockstates, item models, language files, recipes, and tags.

Exact Prism instance metadata, mod list, configs, datapacks, scripts, resource/data packs, shaderpacks, builder version, lab tooling version, and knowledge schema version were hashed by mpb-knowledge fingerprint.
Recipe records were converted from JSON recipe resources with deterministic input and output identifier extraction.
Runtime-affecting Prism directories were enumerated from config, datapacks, scripts, resourcepacks, texturepacks, shaderpacks, defaultconfigs, and generated cache folders.
Tag records were converted from JSON tag resources and linked to referenced registry entries where the tag data provided explicit values.

This pack run covers deterministic static extraction for the selected local Prism instance. Runtime lab and real client validation remain release-blocking manual gates when the Minecraft client is not running.
